verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a self-serve export of contacts, custom fields, tags, or suppression lists. The closest items are programmatic contact import/organization, a 7-day raw export of transactional email events, and SFTP sync connectors. These are adjacent features (import, transactional logs, data sync), not a full audience export in an open format.

support.subject: As a founder, I can export my entire audience — contacts, custom fields, tags, engagement history, and suppression list — in an open format, self-serve
